# regapi_contact (Resource)

A RegAPI contact. A contact's name, prefix and company cannot be changed once it exists; changing them replaces the contact.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "regapi_contact" "client" {
  first_name   = "Maria"
  last_name    = "Papadopoulou"
  company_name = "Papadopoulou IKE"
  email        = "maria@example.gr"
  phone        = "+30.2100000000"
  country_code = "GR"
  street       = "Ermou"
  number       = "12"
  city         = "Athens"
  postal_code  = "10563"
  state        = "Attica"
  tax_id       = "123456789"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `country_code` (String) ISO 3166 country code in upper case, for example GR.
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `first_name` (String) First name. Changing it replaces the contact.
- `last_name` (String) Last name. Changing it replaces the contact.

### Optional

- `city` (String) City.
- `company_name` (String) Company name with its legal form. Changing it replaces the contact.
- `name_prefix` (String) Name prefix, for example "van der". Changing it replaces the contact.
- `number` (String) House number.
- `phone` (String) Phone number as +CC.NUMBER, for example +30.2100000000.
- `postal_code` (String) Postal code.
- `state` (String) Region, required for Greek addresses.
- `street` (String) Street name without the number.
- `suffix` (String) House number suffix, for example A.
- `tax_id` (String) Tax ID, for example the Greek ΑΦΜ.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
